claim: Dropping the real background for an emotional field is standard anime grammar, not a shortcut - the world stops existing because the character has stopped noticing it. Void_black isolates and threatens, emotional_wash floods the frame with a single feeling, radial_burst detonates.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: detailed background, consistent with the scene
sunburst background, radial burst background, emphasis lines
patterned background, polka dot background, repeating motif
white background, simple background, empty void

review.issue: The "matched" clause "detailed background, consistent with the scene" is prose - "consistent with the scene" is an instruction to a human, not a tag - and "detailed background" is a quality push that makes the baseline panel busier than every other card's baseline.
review.fix: Empty clause, matching how anime.bg.hue_relation/matched and anime.color.harmony/free are already handled.

review.issue: Three options are already owned by other cards and will render the same: watercolor here vs anime.bg.style/watercolor, photobash here vs anime.bg.style/photobash, radial_burst here ("sunburst background, radial burst background, emphasis lines") vs shot.fx.screentone/flash_lines and shot.fx.speed_lines/radial.
review.fix: Decide the boundary: bg_treatment should own "replace the world with an emotional field" (void_black, white_void, abstract_color, emotional_wash, pattern) and hand the painting-medium options (watercolor, photobash) to anime.bg.style and the radiating-line options to speed_lines/screentone.
